question: NK 16 is related to QN 12 in a certain way. In the same way, PS 20 is related to SV 16. To which of the given options is BX 30 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3f179d7c422b26a657fc0d191b6521cdc6b8ce211d01d617ad49ad0642bdca3.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, NK 16 → QN 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dded2d7050f4a6416a9b6eb0132ddf1a1d9894c825fa555d87059078d46190f9.png] 

For, PS 20 → SV 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d0ca245ee37f1235019f14c6939d411725110f4fb7a6d3191210b24ba3a8e18.png] 

Now, apply the same to BX 30:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685fa9f9715a987d24081daaf89d38b746dc268d7c2821f1370b09f1ed64e37b.png] 

So, BX 30 → EA 26

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
